question: Name the executive accountable for AI risk and describe your AI governance structure and policy.
Do you hold ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 27001 or SOC 2 Type II covering this product?
Maintain an AI system inventory and risk assessment for this product, reviewed at least annually?
Disclose material sub-processors and foundation-model providers, with locations.
State the EU AI Act risk class you assign and your reasoning.
Describe independent assurance of AI releases (internal review board or external audit).
Is our data excluded from training or tuning any model used for others, by default?
Is there a DPA covering AI processing and cross-border transfers?
Can data be deleted on request, including logs and derived data? Show the procedure.
Are retention periods defined and enforced?
Has a DPIA been completed for this use case? Provide or support one.
Is special-category data inferred or processed? How is it controlled?
Provide validation evidence on data similar to our use case.
Provide a model card or equivalent with limits and out-of-scope uses.
Report accuracy by relevant subgroups and conditions with sample sizes.
Describe drift detection and revalidation after changes.
Can we run our own acceptance test before go-live?
State uptime, latency and accuracy commitments and how they are measured.
Has the system been tested for discriminatory impact on protected groups?
framework_refs: NYC LL144; EEOC UGESP; AI Act Art 10

question: Is the audit independent and within the last 12 months?
Are proxy variables identified and controlled? List features.
Are fairness results shared with customers for each release?
Describe your remediation process when bias is found.
Do you test equal opportunity (qualified individuals), not only overall rates?
Can the system explain, per decision, the factors that drove the output?
Are users told when they interact with AI or when AI informed a decision?
Are model changes communicated in advance, with the ability to stay on a prior version?
Is documentation sufficient for us to meet our own transparency duties?
Do you provide exportable logs for audit?
Is there a public description of the AI features and their limits?
Independent security certification (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001) covering the product?
Tested for AI-specific attacks: prompt injection, poisoning, extraction, adversarial inputs?
Role-based access to our data, logged and reviewed?
Will you notify us of breaches within 72 hours or less?
Tested business continuity and exit plan?
Software supply chain controls (SBOM, dependency scanning, model provenance)?
Can a human review and override any consequential output, with overrides logged?
AI incident process with severity levels and timelines?
Kill switch or ability to suspend features quickly?
User training and guidance on limits and automation bias?
Do you disclose incidents affecting other customers where relevant to us?
Do you provide a candidate or user appeal route support?
Do you map the product to applicable regulation (AI Act class, sector rules)?
Liability for AI errors and IP/data indemnity addressed?
Audit rights and right to documentation on request?
Service levels for accuracy, availability and support?
Right to terminate and retrieve data if non-compliant?
Insurance: cyber and professional indemnity limits?
